titre: [$175] [Sentry: APP-MDA] Android HybridApp crashes adding receipts email contact when default contacts account is cloud
corps:
## Sentry https://expensify.sentry.io/issues/APP-MDA APP-MDA groups several different Java exceptions under a shared native abort frame. This issue tracks only the contacts exception below. ## Impact (snapshot at filing) - Source: [APP-MDA crash classification](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/102742#issuecomment-7004558657), reviewing 611 events from 2026-08-26 through 2026-11-18. Counts below are from that review, not a fresh Sentry query. - Users (total since first seen): not available for this branch - Events: 312 (51.1% of the reviewed APP-MDA events) - Events on 9.5.34-1 or later: 24 - Users (last 14d): not available for this branch - First seen / last seen: not available separately for this branch; reported still happening in the review - Platform: Android HybridApp - App version(s): includes 9.5.34-1 or later; complete affected-version list not available - Affected flow: adding the receipts email address to contacts - OS condition: reported on Android 16+ when the default contacts account is cloud; verify against representative events - Mechanism: SIGABRT, fatal ## Stack trace (top frames, first-party only) The source review identifies this underlying exception; a complete representative event stack has not been attached: ```text IllegalArgumentException: Cannot add contacts to local or SIM accounts when default account is set to cloud ``` ## Suspected cause The contacts operation is rejected when the default account is cloud, and the exception results in an app crash. The precise cause and supported account-handling behavior still require investigation. This appears to be a backend/internal issue. A separate internal investigation is needed. ## Reproduction Not confirmed. Investigate adding the receipts email address to contacts on Android 16+ with a cloud default contacts account. Attach a representative Sentry event and confirm the affected OS/account combinations before treating these as verified reproduction steps. Expected: the app does not crash when adding the contact, including when the contacts account configuration prevents the operation. ## Related - Parent tracker: [Top Sentry crashes monthly check-in](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/91302) - Source: [APP-MDA crash classification](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/102742#issuecomment-7004558657) - Separate original issue: [FragmentManager race in legacy OldDot navigation](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/102742). Its reported fix does not cover this exception. - Sibling Sentry IDs: none identified; this is a distinct exception within APP-MDA, not a new Sentry ID.
